text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-review:
    if: |
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 
       (github.event.action == 'opened' || github.event.action == 'synchronize' || github.event.action == 'reopened')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && 
       github.event.issue.pull_request && 
       github.event.comment.body == '/claude review')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@beta
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          prompt: |
            Please review this pull request with a focus on code comments and documentation consistency.

            ## Summary
            - restore extended @file documentation across popup helpers, entry points, models, search strategies, and views to match legacy detail
            - highlight the scoring pipeline steps so future tuning keeps parity with historical behaviour notes

            ## Testing
            - not run (not requested)

            Please provide specific feedback on:
            1. Whether @file documentation has been restored to match legacy detail levels in popup helpers, entry points, models, search strategies, and views
            2. Whether scoring pipeline steps are clearly documented to maintain parity with historical behavior notes
            3. Any inconsistencies in comment style or documentation format
            4. Suggestions for improving documentation clarity and completeness
```
